(425)༄༅/ /lam sbas te bshad pa man ngag gi zin bris bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (425)༄༅// lam sbas te bshad pa man ngag gi zin bris bzhugs so//

bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad/ (426)༄༅// dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug dang*// rje btsun dam pa snying po'i zhabs// dbyer med dkon mchog mtshan can la// btud de 'khrid tshul mdo tsam bri// de yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir wa pas/ rje btsun sa skya pa la dngos su gnang ba'i gdams ngag /dpal ldan sa skya'i lcags ri'i khang nas mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bzhir grags pa'i nang nas lam sbas te bshad pa/ mchog sgrub pa dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs gnyis las/ 'dir mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir rdo rje 'chang chen po mngon du byed pa'i thabs/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor la brten nas/ dbang bzhi gcig char du nyams su len pa'i tshul la/ de'ang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ slob lam rgyas pa'i khrid yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ ma rdzogs kyang rung ste/ dbang dang dam tshig dang ldan pa tshul bzhin khrid cing*/ gdams pa ston pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsags sbyong gi rnal 'byor lam rgyas pa bzhin zhag grangs ci rigs su bya/ gnyis pa la/ byin rlabs 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi rten bskyed pa'i rim pa gnyis/ thun re'am zung 'brel du sgom pa mdzad de/ de'ang bsam gtan gyi gdan la lus gnad dang ldan pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ bdag gi spyi bor rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ bla ma he ru ka phyag bcu drug pa'am/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par gsal la/ gnas gsum du yi ge bsgoms/(427)thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ bla ma brgyud pa yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro srung ma thams cad spyan drangs bstim la/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor dmigs shing*/

gus 'dud drag po dang bcas pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces pa la sogs pa'i gsol gdab drag po byas pa'i mthar/ bla ma nyid byang sems bde ba chen po'i rnam par zhu ste/ spyi bor thim pas lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ sku gsung thugs dbyer med du 'dres par bsam la mnyam par bzhag /nyams ci skyes byung rgyal du bskyang*/ gnyis pa bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ de nyid kyi rjes su sgom/ 'dir dbang po rnon po'i lam yin pas mngon rtogs rgyas pa sgom mi dgos/ bdag bla mas dal du bcug pa'i dus su dpal kyai rdo rjer bskyed/ de la ye shes pa bcug dbang bskur phyin chad/ kyai rdo rje yin snyam pa byas la/ skad cig gis kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug par gsal btab la/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa la dmigs pa gtad cing sgom/ lam rgyas pa ltar dmigs pa dum khrid byas nas sgom mi dgos ces gsungs so// de dag ni sngon du 'gro ba'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dmigs pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ bca' ba lus kyi gnad/ sgom pa dmigs pa'i gnad/ dgang ba rlung gi gnad gsum las/ dang po ni 'di nyid lus kyi 'khrul 'khor la brten nas nyams su len pa yin pas rje'am shing las byas pa'i 'khor lo dpang sor drug pa/ sbom du mtheb mdzub rtse sprad pa'i bar du (428)shong ba/ rtse mo cung zad phra zhing shin tu 'jam pa tshags byas te/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la 'jug pa'i tshe/ 'bol la sogs pa'i stan bde ba la gnas nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yi dam bsgom pa'i bar sngar bzhin bya/ de nas glang po che'i rna ba lta bu'i skyil krung yangs par byas/ sngar gyi 'khor lo srin bu'i lam gyi thad kar bzhag la/ brla res mos btegs pa dang*/ 'og rlung 'dren pa bstun te/ srin bu'i lam bsdams nas/

'khor lo'i steng du bzhag /cung zad mtho bas mi bde na/ smad ces pa snag po che'i 'og tu stegs mtshams par gzhugs/ lag pa gnyis pus mo la bkab/ tshigs pa drang por bsrangs te bca' ba lus kyi gnad do// gnyis pa ni/ lus la rang bzhin gyi gnas tshul/ glo ba kha mthur la bstan la/ mchin pa 'debs la 'byar te gnas pa la/ de gnyis sgom dus gong 'og rjes nas 'dab brgyad glo ba dkar po kha gyen la bstan pa mchin pa pad+ma dmar smug 'dab brgyad kha thur la bstan/ de gnyis rtse cung zad bsnol ba gzhal yas khang gi tshul du bsam/ rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs la/ snying ga thur la bstan nas gnas kyang*/ blos gyen la bslangs te/ pad+ma gnyis kyi bar du gnas par bsam/ snying de'i dbus su rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i mdud pa hūm̐ gi gzugs su grub pa la dmigs pa gtad/ de nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro bsgom ste/ snying dbus kyi de he ru ka sku mdog sngo nag spyan gsum pa dmar zhing zlum pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing*/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis steng du brgyad g.yon zla steng du bskum pa/ (429)dbu'i gtsug tor dang bcas shing*/ ral pa lnga g.yon du 'phyang ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par sgom/ yum dran tsam las zhal phyag rgyas par gsal gdab mi dgos gang de'ang hūm̐ de rang bzhin gyi he ru ka'i rnam par gnas pa gsal 'debs pa yin gyis/ sa bon lta bur bsgyur nas sgom pa ni ma yin no// de ni sgom pa dmigs pa'i gnad do// gsum pa dgang ba rlung gi gnad ni/ rlung ro lan gsum bus la lto ba cung zad gcer/ lce rkan la sbyar/ mig cung zad bgrad/ spyi bo sa la thug pa ste rlung ha'i gdangs kyis drangs shing*/ rngub ste ro stod sbub cing sib kyis mnan/ steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyar la/ sems kyi dmigs pa thugs rdo rje'i gdan gyi pad 'dab rnams 'dar khri li li g.yo bar bsam mo// mi thub dal bus btang*/

yang spyi bor sa la thug par rngub ste/ rlung sa len ma bya ba yin gsungs/ de ltar rtsa ba'i 'khrul 'khor bdun dang bsrel zhing sgom pas snang ba dkar dmar lam pa 'ong zhes pa'i don dkar lam lam byung na 'ong ba'i rtags dmar lam lam byung na mi 'ong ba'i rtags/ zas bcud can btang zhing sgom/ lte bar dmigs pa mang po sgom pas gal te rnam shes 'pho ba snyam byed/ snying ga tsha lam lam byed na btsan 'phyong btang*/ 'o dod 'bod/ des nges par sel lo// gnyis pa yan lag gi dmigs pa ni/ 'bar dang g.yo dang brtan pa dang*/ zhes pa'i don nyams su len pa yin te/ lus skyil krung*/ lag pa mthe bos srin lag gi rtsa ba mnan pa'i rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bsnol la/ sems kyi dmigs pa lus kyi spyi gtsug nas gsang gnas kyi bar la/ rtsa dbu (430)ma sbom phra gro sogs tsam kha dog dmar po ya yo dang khyag khyog med pa thad la pi ri ba gcig bsam/ rdo rje'i rtsa bar bdud bzhis zil gyis mi gnon pa'i hūm̐ me 'bar ba mgo bo gyen bstan cig bsam/ spyi gtsug tu byang sems kyis gang ba'i haṃ mgo thur bstan cig bsam/ mgo sa la btud de rlung sna bug gnyis nas rngub la kha sbyar bas hūm̐ las hūm̐ me 'bar ba mang po mched/ dbu mar yar mar khrol khrol song bas haṃ gi byang sems la zhu bas/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis mer gyis gang bar bsgoms te/ de nas hūm̐ de them bu bkag pa bzhin bsam/ mar 'dzag pa lta bu ni ma yin no// skabs su man ngag bzhin ha ring bgrang*/ de la gsal ba dang*/ mgrin pa snying ga'i 'khor lo rnams kyang gang bar bsam/ mthar lus thams cad gang bar bsgoms te/ bde bzhin du stong*/ stong bzhin du bde ba/ bde stong gnyis med du bsam/ de lta bu'i lha'i sku 'ja' tshon lta bu la dmigs pa gtad do// nyams ci skyes byung rgyal du bskyang*/ de dag gi skabs su rdul cher byung na lag pas skem mnye/

steng du gcun drag pas sna khrag byung na gan rkyal du nyal te/ cung zad mig la lag pa gnyis khu tshur mgrin par brkyang bas 'chad/ des ma chad na sgro ba 'khyig pa lag len bzhin bya/ 'dzag pa byung na dbang bzhi pa'i lag len bzhin no// de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dmigs pa res mos su bsgoms te dngos gzhi'o// gzhan rnams ni 'khrid yig tu gsal la 'khrid yig tu glo ba steng dang*/ mchin pa 'og tu bsgom par gsungs la/ 'dir steng 'og brje ba ni bla ma'i man ngag dang*/ snying rtsa 'brel bas las dang po la snying gyen du bslang ba'i (431)dmigs pa bde ba'i phyir yin gsungs/ 'phrul 'khor so gnyis ni rtsa ba nas ma bshad pas cis kyang dgos pa ma yin la/ byas na 'gal ba med ces gsungs so// lam sbas te bshad pa'i man ngag gi snying khu rje btsun dam pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung las ji ltar byon pa bzhin/ bya btang pa ma ti'i ming can gyis rang gi brjed byang tsam du yi ger bkod pa la/ chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzad nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag cag gi lam zab mo sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi bar du gcod pa zhi zhing*/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin nas sems can dpag tu med pa'i don byed par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /(432)
